units.source_text: 秀男家只有三台手织机，分别由兄弟三人使用，

en.t: Hideo's family had only three handlooms, which the three brothers used separately,

units.source_text: 父亲宗助偶尔也织织，因此在这小纺织作坊比比皆是的西阵，他们的家境还算过得去。

en.t: and since their father Sosuke also wove from time to time, their family was fairly well off in Nishijin, where small weaving workshops were everywhere.
